component: EC202 Direct Air Capture — Liquid Solvent (KOH/Ca(OH)2)
description: Part-load + solvent degradation model for liquid-solvent DAC (Carbon Engineering style)

unit.name: 1 MtCO2/yr Reference Plant Module
unit.source: Keith et al. (2018) Joule 2(8) 1573-1594; McQueen et al. (2021) Progress in Energy 3(3)

Q_calciner_base.note: Base calciner thermal duty at design (Keith 2018: ~7-9 GJ/tCO2)

T_calciner_ref.note: Reference calciner temperature for CaCO3 decomposition

alpha_calciner.note: Temperature sensitivity: 10% lower T -> ~3% higher duty

k_cap_koh.note: KOH absorber capacity per unit area at design

n_contactors.note: Number of air contactors in plant

k_deg.note: KOH capacity loss rate due to K2CO3 build-up (~5%/yr)
